Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description: A personal or online-imported culinary recipe belonging to a user, synced via Cloud Firestore and cached for offline viewing.

title.description: Title of the recipe (1 to 140 characters).

description.description: Short summary or headnote for the recipe (up to 1000 characters).

sourceType.description: Whether the recipe is a personal creation or imported/saved from online.

sourceUrl.description: Optional source webpage URL for online recipes.

sourceName.description: Optional source label or domain name.

ingredients.description: Ordered list of recipe ingredients (1 to 100 items).

steps.description: Ordered list of preparation instructions (1 to 100 items).

favorite.description: Whether the user marked this recipe as a favorite.

offlinePinned.description: Whether the recipe is pinned by the user for offline kitchen access.

notes.description: Personal kitchen notes and tweaks (up to 2000 characters).

/users/{userId}/recipes/{recipeId}.description: User-isolated personal and online recipes subcollection.
